findings.title: distant demonstrative sets the class apart
findings.claim: The non-judging group is pointed out at a grammatical and moral distance before the predicate names it.
findings.mechanism: The distant plural demonstrative opens the nominal verdict, so the subject is first set apart as those people and only then identified by the final class label.
findings.reader_payoff: The warning's distance is felt before the word wrongdoers arrives.
findings.containment: The finding describes the demonstrative's local pointing effect and does not turn it into a separate judgment beyond the predicate.

epistemic.reason: The aligned demonstrative and trusted supports directly establish the pointed-out verdict subject.

findings.title: separating pronoun sharpens identity
findings.claim: The verdict identifies the pointed-out group emphatically as the wrongdoers.
findings.mechanism: The independent pronoun separates subject from predicate and locks the demonstrative group to its class label in the compact nominal frame.
findings.reader_payoff: The final identification sounds precise rather than merely descriptive.
findings.containment: The emphasis strengthens the local identification but does not add a new class or resolve matters outside the phrase.

epistemic.reason: The pronoun's aligned nominal role and trusted supports directly establish the emphatic identification.

findings.title: wrongdoers seal the ayah
findings.claim: Refusal to judge by what was sent down is finally named as wrongdoing and misplacement.
findings.mechanism: The definite active participle converts the conditional violators into a recognized class, while its supported wrong-placement pressure gives the closing label a concrete moral direction.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the withheld judgment is not merely procedural failure: it leaves a due or order out of place.
findings.containment: The local predicate remains wrongdoers; darkness and other root branches are not activated as separate readings.

epistemic.reason: The aligned participle and trusted supports directly establish the wrongdoing verdict and its bounded root pressure.

findings.title: scriptural container for the prescription
findings.claim: The prescription is located inside a scriptural container while remaining grammatically distinct from the community upon whom it rests.
findings.mechanism: The feminine suffix after fī supplies an internal location for the written content, separating where the rule resides from whom the earlier phrase burdens.
findings.reader_payoff: The wording gives the statute both a textual home and an addressed community.
findings.containment: The container relation is limited to the supplied locative phrase and does not reconstruct unsupplied scriptural text.

epistemic.reason: The locative alignment and trusted supports directly establish the textual-container relation.

findings.title: assertive content clause houses the list
findings.claim: The body-part sequence is housed as asserted written content under one governing clause.
findings.mechanism: The standard anna particle governs the following accusative list and lets the noun-for-noun units function as the content of katabna, while the packet preserves independent-equation pressure as a qualified alternative.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the whole catalogue held together by one assertion even where the organs arrive as separate pairs.
findings.containment: The standard governed structure is retained alongside the qualified variant pressure; neither is used to erase the other.

epistemic.reason: The governing content relation is supported, while alternate case architecture is explicitly marked as qualification.

findings.title: whole person starts the cascade
findings.claim: The statute starts with the bounded whole person-life before descending into organs and wounds.
findings.mechanism: The first definite singular accusative under anna carries the local person-life unit, and its position anchors the later bodily cascade as a movement from whole to part.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the list's scale change from an entire life to particular sites of injury.
findings.containment: The focus term remains person-life in this legal unit; breath, blood, soul, and other supported root associations are not separately activated.

epistemic.reason: The first aligned term and trusted supports directly establish its position and local semantic range.

findings.title: first exchange bāʾ establishes the formula
findings.claim: The first bāʾ establishes equivalence as the relation that joins the two life terms.
findings.mechanism: Its placement between the first life term and its definite counterpart narrows the preposition to exchange, creating the formula that the later organ pairs can inherit.
findings.reader_payoff: The exactness of the statute is heard in a small relational word before the catalogue expands.
findings.containment: The finding concerns the local equivalence use of bāʾ and does not claim that every bāʾ in Arabic has this value.

epistemic.reason: The focus alignment, repetition, and trusted supports directly establish the local exchange use.

findings.title: second life term completes the mirror
findings.claim: The second life term repeats the whole person-life as the exact exchange counterpart.
findings.mechanism: The same definite n-f-s form returns in the genitive after bāʾ, so the case marks the response side while the person-life identity remains fixed.
findings.reader_payoff: The first pair reads as person-life against person-life rather than as a scale of approximate value.
findings.containment: The finding preserves the case change and does not extend the local legal term to every possible root association.

epistemic.reason: The repeated focus lexeme and trusted supports directly establish the counterpart relation.

findings.title: connector adds the eye as a new unit
findings.claim: The conjunction makes the eye a new coordinated legal unit after the life pair.
findings.mechanism: Its placement before the eye coordinates a fresh item while preserving the established matching rule, preventing the eye from being absorbed into the first life clause.
findings.reader_payoff: The list advances by visible units instead of collapsing into one undifferentiated statement.
findings.containment: The connector contributes coordination and order only; it does not supply the eye's lexical meaning.

epistemic.reason: The focus alignment and trusted supports directly establish the new coordinated item.

findings.title: proportional correspondence also limits response
findings.claim: The catalogue can be read as a ceiling as well as an authorization: response is confined to a precisely corresponding life, organ, or wound.
findings.mechanism: The attributed HFT trace returns through the matched self, eye, and qisas contacts: repeated X-bi-X pairs supply the corresponding units and qisas names the proportional mechanism, so the same catalogue that permits response also bounds it.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive limitation inside the catalogue's repeated correspondences without losing its plain retaliation sense.
findings.containment: This is attributed contextual evidence from a legacy-unbound HFT trace anchored wholly in 5:45; it does not claim that the catalogue has no authorizing force or establish a broader legal conclusion.

epistemic.reason: The focus coordinates, roots, and return are supplied exactly, but the HFT source identity is legacy_unbound, so the reading remains attributed.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: şeyin kendisi ve bütün öz varlığı
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin bütün gerçeği ve öz varlığıyla kendisini pekiştirerek gösterir.
branch_activations.carrier: İki eşleşen n-f-s biçimi, birimin bizzat kendisini ve bütün öz varlığını taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: İki tarafı aynı bāʾ ile bağlayan X-bi-X eşleşmesi ve sonunda gelen qisas, birimin özdeş karşılığını tetikler.
branch_activations.activation: Özdeş iki life-term biçimi, tekrarlanan exchange relation içinde karşılıklı birim olarak buluşur; qisas da bu buluşmayı ölçülü karşılık olarak adlandırır.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Katalog yalnızca karşılık vermeye izin veren bir dizi değil, karşılığı tam olarak denk gelen can, organ veya yarayla sınırlayan bir tavandır.
branch_activations.boundary: Bu dal yalnız özdeşlik ve pekiştirme kalıbında, HFT'nin atfettiği yerel rolde kullanılır; canlılık, kan, soluk veya daha geniş bir norm iddiası eklenmez.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Görme yetisinin bedendeki organını ve bu organla gerçekleşen görmeyi belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: Eşleşen eye biçimleri, görme organını somut karşılık birimi olarak taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: İkinci eye önündeki bāʾ ve qisasın ölçülü karşılık adı, organın yalnızca para veya soyut değer olmadığını tetikler.
branch_activations.activation: Somut eye pair, aynı exchange syntax içinde karşılıklı organ birimi olur; qisas bu correspondence mekanizmasını hukuki ölçüye bağlar.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Karşılık, soyut bir değer değil, görülen zararla tam olarak eşleşen organ sınırı içinde okunur.
branch_activations.boundary: Bu dal organ ve görme işleviyle sınırlıdır; gözetme, zarar veren bakış veya benzetmeli kullanımlar eklenmez.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Yapılan zarara ya da doğan hakka aynı ölçüde bir karşılık verme ilkesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: Qisas, yaraya ve organlara verilen karşılığın denkliğini taşıyan isimdir.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Öncesindeki tekrarlanan life/organ X-bi-X pairs, qisas için somut ölçü ve karşılık yüzeyi sağlar.
branch_activations.activation: Qisas, ayrı ayrı eşleşen yaralanma birimlerini tek bir proportional mechanism altında toplar ve karşılığın sınırını görünür kılar.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Liste, bodily retaliation yetkisini bildirirken aynı anda cevabın ilk zarar veya hakla denk kalacağı bir sınır kurar.
branch_activations.boundary: Bu atıf genel ceza veya daha geniş bir hukuk sistemi iddiası değildir; yalnız focus ayah içindeki denk karşılık rolünü taşır.

findings.title: claim can be given and become covering
findings.claim: The measured legal claim itself can be donated, and that donation can perform a covering act without resolving the beneficiary of lahu.
findings.mechanism: The attributed trace joins the charity action at tṣaddaqa to the expiation noun kaffara: the right-holder's relinquishment turns an enforceable claim into a gift, and the result names covering or effacement.
findings.reader_payoff: The mercy clause becomes an action on the claim itself, with expiation as a consequence rather than mere optional leniency.
findings.containment: The reading is attributed to the legacy-unbound HFT trace and stays within the supplied claim, waiver, and covering coordinates; lahu remains referentially open.

epistemic.reason: The focus anchor and root contacts are exact, but the HFT source identity is legacy_unbound, so the semantic relation is attributed.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: mal vererek yardım etme veya haktan vazgeçme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişinin kendi hakkından bağışlayarak vazgeçmesi de mali yardım gibi değerlendirilir.
branch_activations.carrier: Tṣaddaqa, kişinin kendi pay veya hakkından vazgeçerek verme eylemini taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Whoever condition and the attached bihi object make the charitable act operate on a defined claim.
branch_activations.activation: The actor introduced by man performs charity on the preceding claim through bihi, so relinquishment is a transfer of one's due rather than bare inaction.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Measured legal claim itself can be donated as a charitable relinquishment.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed trace does not generalize to every charitable transfer or decide the exact legal beneficiary.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Günahın yükünü örten veya silen karşılık ya da işlem.
branch_activations.carrier: Kaffara, relinquishment sonrası günah veya yükü örten ve gideren sonucu taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The preceding charity action and result pronoun connect the covering noun to a relinquished legal claim.
branch_activations.activation: Kaffara meets the completed waiver at the result boundary, turning the gift of the claim into remedial covering beyond simple non-enforcement.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Donation of the measured claim performs a covering act while lahu remains unresolved.
branch_activations.boundary: Only the supplied expiation/covering role is attributed; concealment, denial, and unrelated covering branches are not claimed.

findings.title: judgment as protective enactment
findings.claim: Failure to judge by what was sent down can be read as actively withholding another's due and defeating the norm's protective function.
findings.mechanism: The attributed trace joins written obligation, restraint, proper placement, and withholding at the focus coordinates: an entrusted norm requires enactment that restrains wrong, while refusal leaves a due confined and displaced.
findings.reader_payoff: The closing wrongdoing label can be felt as a concrete harm produced by withheld judgment, while the ordinary warning remains recoverable.
findings.containment: This is an attributed legacy-unbound HFT reading anchored wholly in 5:45; it does not invent a branch gloss beyond the supplied facets or claim that omission has no other dimensions.

epistemic.reason: All coordinates and roots return to the supplied focus surface, but the HFT source is legacy_unbound and therefore remains attributed.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bağlayıcı olarak hükme bağlama ve belirleme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir işi yapılması gereken bağlayıcı bir yükümlülük olarak belirlemek temel değerlerden biridir.
branch_activations.carrier: Katabna, following content as a binding written determination carries the entrusted norm.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The asserted content frame and the named equivalence rule give the writing a determinate obligation to enact.
branch_activations.activation: The writing verb meets the body catalogue as its binding content, so the list becomes a norm that judgment must carry into action.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The later refusal is failure to enact an entrusted, binding determination.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed use is binding determination in this focus clause, not mere physical writing or an unsupplied destiny claim.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel işlem, birini istediği veya yöneldiği şeyden ya da bir şeyi bozulmadan alıkoyup geri çevirmektir.
branch_activations.carrier: Yahkum, judgment as an act that can restrain and turn back harm carries the local refusal.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Lam's negation and the bima criterion make the restrained act a judgment by a delivered measure.
branch_activations.activation: The judgment verb meets the restraint facet at the point where the revealed measure should hold wrong back, so not judging can leave harm unrestrained.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Non-judgment actively withholds the protective restraint expected from the norm.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed branch is restraint, not the separate judging, strengthening, or permission branches of the root.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bir şeyi uygun yerine veya sırasına koyma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey düzenlenir ve kendisine uygun yere, sıraya veya dereceye konur.
branch_activations.carrier: Anzala, the delivered criterion as placed and made available in its proper station, carries the order pressure.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The criterion bāʾ and the judgment verb specify that the descended content is the measure to be properly enacted.
branch_activations.activation: The delivered standard meets the ordering facet through the requirement that judgment place the revealed measure in its proper operative position.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Refusal to judge dislocates the delivered order from the place where it should govern.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed use is proper placement/order in the supplied criterion relation, not ordinary physical descent or every delivery sense.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kisileri kendilerine ait paylardan alikoymak veya bu paylari vermemek cekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: Zalimun, the named wrongdoer class, carries the consequence of withholding a due.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The negated judgment act and its revealed criterion identify whose due is confined when the standard is not enacted.
branch_activations.activation: The wrongdoing predicate meets the withholding facet through the concrete relation between a refused judgment and the due that remains unpaid or misplaced.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The wrongdoer label names active withholding of another's due, not only generic disobedience.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed branch is withholding a due in this judgment clause; darkness, mere reduction, and unrelated access barriers are excluded.

friction_notes: The packet supplies a complete focus-surface/QAC alignment and no selected non-focus context units or inter-ayah connections; contextual claims were therefore kept local and no non-focus carrier or trigger was retained.
The three HFT records are legacy_unbound but have complete focus anchors, word indices, roots, and focus returns; they remain visible as attributed activations rather than independent lexical proof.

Root branch inventories contain many available alternatives, but no additional branch was activated without an independent focus trigger and changed local reading; root membership alone was not treated as activation.
